messages:
Maria Chen: heads-up — I'm about to create the annotated tag for v1.18.0-rc3 and open the GH draft. Quick sanity check: who can own the binary upload + add changelog link? Also want to ensure our signed tag is using infra-release key.
Ben Patel: I can grab the binary upload. planning to be around in 15m. do we have the signed tag ready?
Maria Chen: signing step is done locally with infra-release@gpg (I pushed the detached sig to staging storage). command I used:
```
git tag -a v1.18.0-rc3 -m "v1.18.0 rc3" && gpg --detach-sign --armor v1.18.0-rc3 && git push origin v1.18.0-rc3 && git push origin refs/tags/v1.18.0-rc3 --follow-tags
```
Ben Patel: looks good. i'll upload linux/x86_64 and macOS tarballs to the draft release and add checksums.
Carla Gomez: quick nudge — changelog entry for #4021 ("kv cache eviction fix") is missing link to the issue. can someone lint the markdown? small bot can check.
Sophia Li: I ran the changelog linter in CI and it flagged a missing issue link and a trailing whitespace. i'll attach the fixed snippet in a sec.
Sophia Li: ```
- Fix: kv cache eviction causing evicted entries to persist (#4021) — fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/4021
```
Maria Chen: perfect, can you paste that into the draft release notes when you have bandwidth? Ben, once you upload assets please add the changelog markdown and the sha256 sums.
Ben Patel: will do. ETA 25m. ping me here if anything blocks.
release-bot: deploy-checklist: signatures verified, build artifacts present on staging-bucket, checksum generation pending :gear:
Carla Gomez: another tiny ask — can we include the binary provenance URL in the draft notes: https://staging-artifacts.internal/redwood/1.18.0-rc3/prov.json
Maria Chen: yes please. and tag the release with the GPG key fingerprint `4F3A 9C1B 7E2D 9A0C 1234 5678 90AB CDEF 1234 5678` in the notes.
Ben Patel: uploaded assets and added sha256 sums + provenance link. draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.18.0-rc3 (draft)
Maria Chen: awesome — final checklist for main thread: 1) annotated tag pushed (done), 2) signed tag fingerprint included in notes (done), 3) binaries uploaded + checksums (done), 4) changelog entry linked (done), 5) assignees for shiproom? @carla or @sophia volunteer?
Carla Gomez: I can own shiproom coordination for the publish step. i'll schedule the 10m sync.
Maria Chen: thanks! I'll flip the GH draft to "publish" after shiproom ok. :thumbsup:
Ben Patel: thanks team.
Carla Gomez: :rocket:
